children: Aqua Metals disclosed that Benchmark assigned its ATM sales agreement to StoneX Financial, transferring rights and obligations under the offering arrangement.
Benchmark assigned its rights and obligations under Aqua Metals' ATM Sales Agreement to affiliate StoneX Financial Inc.
Assignment notified on Sept. 2, 2026; Benchmark's prior role began under the agreement dated Aug. 30, 2024 (amended Dec. 2, 2025).
Assignment permitted under Section 13 of the Sales Agreement without Aqua Metals' consent.
